title: Hog Quest: Good Boy
tagline: A pawsitively tiny RPG from PostHog

music.mood: playful, bouncy, cheeky, walk in the park

text.win: Every walk booked, every crash fetched, every problem sent home happy. Very good dev.
text.lose: The bugs chewed up the booking flow. Have a treat and try again.
text.credits: Made with love (and dog puns) for Pawprint by PostHog

intro: You trot into Pawprint HQ. It smells like dog treats and hotfixes.
Four problems are loose in the office. Time to take them for a walk.

rooms.name: The Front Porch
rooms.description: Leashes on hooks. A water bowl labelled 'CI'.

rooms.name: The Kennel
rooms.description: Where the app gets built. Mostly fur-free.

rooms.name: The Doghouse
rooms.description: Nobody is allowed in here. You are in here.

rooms.name: The Treat Room
rooms.description: Snacks for humans. Snacks for dogs. Same shelf.

npcs.name: Biscuit
lines: Woof! (Biscuit has seen the Android app crash. Biscuit is worried.)
Woof woof. (Also, Biscuit would like a walk.)
npcs.sprite_prompt: a small corgi wearing a purple Pawprint bandana

npcs.name: Leash
lines: The Android app crashes mid-booking. No stack trace. Just vibes.
I've been reading tea leaves. And logcat. Mostly tea leaves.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a mobile engineer with an orange beanie and two phones

npcs.name: Fetch
lines: Half of started bookings never finish.
Is it the price step? The calendar? The dog photo upload? Who knows!
npcs.sprite_prompt: a product manager in a purple hoodie holding a tennis ball

npcs.name: Query
lines: Every day someone asks for 'just one quick SQL query'.
I have written that quick query four hundred times.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a data analyst with a headlamp surrounded by sticky notes

npcs.name: Alpha
lines: I used to make games. This office is basically a boss rush.
The Crashhound is the final boss. Obviously.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a CTO in a retro game t-shirt holding a controller

enemies.name: Android Flea
enemies.intro: Android Flea hops out! It's small. It's everywhere.
talk: You ask where it bites. It says 'somewhere in the booking screen'.
You promise to find the exact spot. It stops hopping for a second.
enemies.solve_line: The stack trace points to one null pet photo. Android Flea is finally flea-ed.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a tiny green flea with a cracked phone for a shell

enemies.name: Cart Abandoner
enemies.intro: Cart Abandoner wanders in pushing an empty basket.
talk: You ask why it stopped. It says the calendar was confusing.
You ask if a shorter flow would help. It wags hopefully.
enemies.solve_line: A two-step booking beats the five-step one by 23%. Cart Abandoner books a walk.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a purple beetle pushing a tiny empty shopping basket

enemies.name: SQL Request Tick
enemies.pain: Can you just pull me one quick query?
enemies.intro: SQL Request Tick latches on. It has 'just one quick question'.
talk: You ask what it needs. It needs nine things. By lunch.
You suggest letting people answer their own questions. It loosens its grip.
enemies.solve_line: Bookings, payments and walkers, all queryable in one place. The tick drops off, satisfied.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a fat orange tick covered in sticky notes

boss.name: The Crashhound
boss.pain: Nobody knows why the app crashes, or who it hits.
boss.intro: The Crashhound bursts out of the treat cupboard, growling in stack traces.
talk: You ask who's a good app. It growls. It is not a good app yet.
You offer to watch what really happens before a crash. Its ears perk up.
You scratch behind its ears. It rolls over. Belly up, bugs out.
boss.solve_line: You replay the crash: a double-tap on 'Book'. One debounce later, the Crashhound sits.
boss.sprite_prompt: a giant purple bug shaped like a snarling bulldog with a spiked collar
boss.taunt: Who's a bad app? YOU'RE a bad app! GRRR!

ending: The Crashhound curls up on the office couch and starts snoring.
Bookings flow, walkers walk, and Biscuit finally gets that walk.
